title: Question about action game maker / pixel game maker

posts.author: PersistentDreamerGames
posts.body:
Does it work the same way with other rpgmaker games, where you can use default assets from one engine interchangeably with the other? Like could I use action game maker assets in rpgmaker and so on?
Considering getting, but curious about the assets themselves and what's included in the engine.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Nope, they have no relationship whatsoever. Speaking for PGM only since I ain't tryna shill out money for a unity addon, but PGM is more like a "real" engine where you you can basically import any sprite sheets and just define the cell size or animation order however you want. It also doesn't really come with default assets. (I think there was a default tutorial game or something, but it's really nothing you could call an "RTP" on there)

Yes, you can use the assets from Maker engines (art, audio, etc) with any game engine (even Godot, Unity, or Unreal) with their new terms. The only thing is you must own the Maker engine the assets come in and that engine must be on the list (linked below). Also this might not cover other DLC publishers, so make sure to verify each DLC.
RPG Maker Official | Gotcha Gotcha Games
Let's make games easily!　「RPG Maker Official」
rpgmakerofficial.com
Now you may have to setup the sprite sheets differently because as
@SGHarlekin
mentioned, they will not be setup for RPG Maker. AGMaker in particularly is setup for bone animation, so a lot of the character assets don't have actual animations. Maybe RPG Maker has a bone plugin I'm not aware of though?
Hope that helps!
